mutation.coordinate: aligned gate/up rows plus matching down-projection columns for one contiguous intermediate-channel group

history.supervision: public calibration inputs plus frozen-base oracle outputs; no original Granite training data required
history.teacher_target: frozen-base next-token top-1 for group-importance probing; frozen-base full next-token distribution for KL preservation training

selection.new_signal: mean squared gradient of new-task target NLL over frozen training batches
selection.history_importance: mean squared gradient of frozen-base top-1 NLL over history-selection batches
selection.route_specificity: new-task expert top-k coverage minus history-selection expert top-k coverage
selection.tie_break: higher score, then lower expert index, then lower group index

training.checkpoint_rule: among evaluated nonzero candidates satisfying the history-selection KL budget, restore the checkpoint with maximum new-task train NLL gain; ties choose the earlier step
training.optimizer: manual masked SGD on one aligned intermediate group only, with frozen-base KL distillation on history-selection prompts

decision.formal_support: at least 2 of 3 formal seeds pass
decision.claim_if_supported: under explicit frozen-base historical supervision, a substantially sub-expert aligned parameter coordinate exists that can acquire a new held-out behavior while preserving unseen historical calibration behavior under the frozen protocol
decision.claim_if_rejected: even with explicit frozen-base historical supervision, this protocol did not find a sufficiently local sub-expert writable coordinate; this challenges the current functional-coordinate construction but does not prove that no safe coordinate exists under any representation or optimizer
not_claimed: the selected group is a CLM Cell
